summary.text: Connie Steinmetz is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 87, an office she has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An elementary school teacher by profession, she holds degrees from the University of Missouri, Columbia and Maryville University.

paragraphs.text: Connie Steinmetz was born in Kansas City, Kansas, and earned a high school diploma from J.C. Harmon High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri, Columbia in 1983, and a graduate degree from Maryville University in 1989.
Ballotpedia says her career experience includes working as an elementary school teacher and that she has been affiliated with HNEA, MNEA, Kiwanis and the Chamber of Commerce.
Steinmetz assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Paula Brown, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee, the Children and Families Committee and the Pensions Committee.
